name: agent-runner

surface.GET /conversation (WebSocket upgrade): R1-R4: one conversation request, its relays and its answer

build.dependencies: package-lock.json (npm ci; the Agent SDK pinned exactly)

note: The fleet-member marker of a container member: it has no Worker bundle. `image.digest` is written by the release when it first publishes the image (T33-D1), and an install names the image only as `repository@digest` (src/manifest.mjs imageReference, R7). `egress` is the member's network allow-list, applied by whoever deploys the container (R10).
